name: BlueprintViewer3

variantOf.note: The 'Multi-Floor Split' variation of the Building Viewer template's Blueprint Viewer variant — a fixed multi-floor split canvas with a compound→house drill navigator and a milestones/progress panel. Sibling variation: 'Single Floor' (core-blueprint-viewer).

intent: A v3 iteration of the single-blueprint viewing workspace: a fixed multi-floor split canvas (drag to pan) with a collapsed, drill-down canvas navigator (compound → zone → house → floor) top-left, and a scrollable full-height details panel on the right — the active house's approved-vs-planned progress, a collapsible milestones table, and a Building Progress floor list. A breadcrumb + week-selector metric bar frames the top, with a full-screen toggle.
when: Inspect a house's floors as a fixed multi-blueprint split, panning the whole canvas
Drill a compound → zone → house hierarchy from a collapsed top-left navigator
Show a house's approved-vs-planned progress, milestones, and per-floor completion in a side panel
whenNot: The canonical single-floor pan/zoom viewer with a Show-Multiple toggle -> use the 'Single Floor' variation (BlueprintViewer)
A geospatial map or org KPI overview -> use the Dashboard template

chooseOver.because: The 'Multi-Floor Split' variation is a fixed multi-floor split canvas with a compound→house drill navigator and a milestones + progress details panel, rather than the 'Single Floor' variation's single-floor viewer with a Show-Multiple toggle.

regions.role: Top bar: breadcrumb trail (compound → zone → house → floor) on the left, week selector + full-screen toggle on the right
Fixed multi-floor split canvas (one segment per floor); drag anywhere to pan all segments together
regions.source: FloorPlan (local SVG) + SplitBlueprints (local) inside a pointer-driven pan surface

regions.role: Collapsed top-left canvas navigator drilling compound → zone → house → floor; selecting a house drives the canvas + panel
Full-height right panel: approved-vs-planned progress hero, a collapsible milestones table, and a Building Progress floor list that highlights the selected floor
